acceptance_criteria: When internal_job_secrets has no usable shift_runtime_processor_cron secret and SHIFT_RUNTIME_CRON_SECRET is absent or empty, shift-runtime-processor must return HTTP 503 with a non-sensitive service_unavailable response before any business query or mutation.
If the internal_job_secrets lookup cannot provide a usable secret and no environment fallback exists, the function must fail closed with HTTP 503 rather than continue processing.
When a server-side secret exists, a missing or incorrect x-cron-key must return HTTP 401 and produce zero writes to shift_runtime_events and attendance_logs.
When x-cron-key matches the configured server-side secret, the existing shift processing behavior must remain functional without changing its business semantics.
The table secret keeps precedence over SHIFT_RUNTIME_CRON_SECRET and the environment value remains only a fallback when the table does not provide a usable secret.
No response, test fixture, console log or evidence artifact may expose the configured secret value.
TREQ-PROC-1490, TREQ-SUPABASE-005, TREQ-SUPABASE-006 and TREQ-SUPABASE-1760 must each have an explicit oracle and at least one reproducible PASS assertion in the GAP-PKG-001 evidence set.
The package must not modify database schema, RLS, grants, public.run_shift_runtime_processor(), the five-minute cron schedule, document-alerts, supabase/config.toml or unrelated Edge Functions.
All package-specific tests and the canonical npm test --silent regression facade must complete with zero required failures before the physical implementation can be considered verified.
rollback_steps: Before deployment, capture the currently deployed shift-runtime-processor version and source identity and verify only the presence, never the value, of the configured cron secret.

If the new Edge Function deployment causes a functional regression, redeploy the previously captured source only while a non-empty cron secret is verified; if secret presence cannot be verified, keep the processor unavailable rather than restore fail-open execution.

After any rollback, verify the configured-secret cron invocation path, confirm denied requests still have zero business mutations whenever the hardened version is active, and preserve sanitized execution evidence.
No database rollback is required for GAP-PKG-001 because this package authorizes no schema, migration, RLS, grant or persistent data transformation.
